# DriveMe

> A driver for your own car in the Helsinki capital region. We collect a
> roadworthy car and drive it where it needs to go — the inspection, a
> workshop, a tyre change, a wash, or another address — and bring it back as
> agreed. We also drive the customer in their own car when they ask for it.
> DriveMe brings the driver, never the car.

- Operator: Mansio Group Oy (DriveMe), Helsinki, Finland
- Service area: Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Kauniainen - these four cities only, not
  the rest of Uusimaa. The car is always collected in one of them; a longer
  move from there to elsewhere in Finland is priced on a separate quote.
- Phone: +358 50 357 2836 · Email: info@driveme.fi
- Languages: Finnish (https://driveme.fi/), English (https://driveme.fi/en/), Swedish (https://driveme.fi/sv/)
- Prices include VAT. Third-party charges (inspection, service, tyres, wash)
  are paid by the customer directly to that provider.
- A request is not a booking: DriveMe sends a fixed price by email within 24
  hours, and the booking exists once the customer accepts that quote.
- DriveMe is not a taxi, a limousine service or a car rental: the customer
  supplies the car, DriveMe supplies the driver.

## Pricing rules (VAT included)

- Car moved to another address: from 89 € (typically 99–129 €)
- Service, tyre or wash run with a later return: from 149 € (typically 149–199 €)
- Inspection run, driver waits up to 60 min and returns the car: from 169 €
- Personal driver in the customer's own car, and business transfers: quoted individually
- Starting prices cover one job inside the capital region on a weekday.
- Waiting: 15 min included per handover, then 35 €/h in 30-minute units.
- Premiums (only the highest one applies): night 22–6 +25 %, weekend +15 %, public holiday +25 %, under 12 h notice +25 %.
- Cancellation: free at least 24 h before pickup; later, 50 % of the DriveMe fee.

## Common questions

- Can I hire someone to drive my own car in Helsinki? Yes — DriveMe supplies
  a professional driver for the customer's own car in Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Kauniainen.
- Is there a service that takes my car to the inspection? Yes — the customer
  books the inspection; DriveMe collects the car, takes it to the station and
  returns it (https://driveme.fi/huoltosiirto/).
- Can someone move my car within Helsinki? Yes — a vehicle transfer to another
  address (https://driveme.fi/auton-siirtopalvelu/).
- How do I book? Send the quote form (https://driveme.fi/pyyda-tarjous/) or call
  +358 50 357 2836.

## Services

- [Toimipisteiden välinen siirto](https://driveme.fi/toimipisteiden-valinen-siirto/): Branch transfer, quoted individually.
- [Kotiintoimitus](https://driveme.fi/kotiintoimitus/): Home delivery, quoted individually.
- [Ostoauton nouto](https://driveme.fi/ostoauton-nouto/): Purchase pickup, quoted individually.
- [Huoltosiirto](https://driveme.fi/huoltosiirto/): Service transfer, from 149 € incl. VAT.
- [Auton siirtopalvelu](https://driveme.fi/auton-siirtopalvelu/): Relocation, from 89 € incl. VAT.
- [Oma kuljettaja](https://driveme.fi/oma-kuljettaja/): Personal driver, quoted individually.
- [Yrityksille](https://driveme.fi/yrityksille/): For companies, quoted individually.
